definitions.explanation: Flour made from ground wheat, used in baking and cooking.

examples.japanese: {小麦粉|こむぎこ}をふるいにかける。
examples.notes: ふるいにかける means to sift

examples.japanese: {唐揚|からあ}げを{作|つく}るには{小麦粉|こむぎこ}か{片栗粉|かたくりこ}を{使|つか}います。
examples.english: To make fried chicken, you use either wheat flour or potato starch.

examples.japanese: {小麦粉|こむぎこ}と{水|みず}を{混|ま}ぜて{生地|きじ}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Mix flour and water to make dough.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷらの{衣|ころも}は{小麦粉|こむぎこ}と{冷水|れいすい}で{作|つく}る。
examples.english: Tempura batter is made with wheat flour and cold water.

examples.japanese: {小麦粉|こむぎこ}アレルギーの{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えているので、{米粉|こめこ}を{使|つか}ったパンも{売|う}られている。
examples.english: Since more people have wheat flour allergies, bread made with rice flour is also sold.

notes:
{小麦粉|こむぎこ} is the general term for flour made from wheat. It is the most common type of flour used in Japanese cooking.

WORD FORMATION:
{小麦|こむぎ} (wheat) + {粉|こ} (powder, flour)

TYPES OF WHEAT FLOUR:
- {薄力粉|はくりきこ}: cake flour (low gluten — for cakes, tempura)
- {中力粉|ちゅうりきこ}: all-purpose flour (medium gluten — for udon)
- {強力粉|きょうりきこ}: bread flour (high gluten — for bread)

COMMON USES:
- {天|てん}ぷら: tempura batter
- お{好|この}み{焼|や}き: okonomiyaki
- うどん: udon noodles
- パン: bread

RELATED:
- {片栗粉|かたくりこ}: potato starch (used for frying, thickening)
- {米粉|こめこ}: rice flour (gluten-free alternative)
